StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_77.text: Won't say no to a bit of ink.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_78.text: I've picked worse in my time.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_79.text: A monkey? Not exactly what I expected...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_82.text: Before you go cryin' animal cruelty, remember you started this.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_84.text: Not bad. Should keep an eye out for more of these.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_85.text: Turns out dying's not so bad!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_86.text: Always imagined death would be more... deadly.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_87.text: Seems like a good place to lock someone up and throw away the key.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_88.text: It's easy to talk of justice. Living it's another matter.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_89.text: Faith don't count for much when nobody's listenin'.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_90.text: Can't say these guards didn't deserve it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_95.text: Well well, look what turned up.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_97.text: Power's power. Don't much care where it comes from.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_98.text: Locked up and left to rot... Poor bastards never stood a chance.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_100.text: Thick as a banker's skull. Whatever's down here, they didn't want it gettin' out.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_101.text: It's a damn bathhouse down here - and not the fun kind!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_102.text: Look, mate, I didn't put you here!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_108.text: No need to thank me for freein' ya.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Ugh, that stench... Is this an island or a bloody hatchery?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_110.text: Could make a mean omelette with all these...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_111.text: Here we are - the big ugly bird herself!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_114.text: That's for making me see... all that!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_115.text: Who'd build a shrine on this cursed rock?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_116.text: More shrines. Am I following them, or are they following me?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_117.text: This is a Karui rite of passage? I'll take Trarthus any day.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_118.text: Great. Whole flock's watchin'. This should go well.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_119.text: Don't suppose any of these friendly folk could offer me a beer.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_120.text: Friendly faces. Pointy spears. Something's not adding up.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_121.text: Can't wait to see this Utopia they've been banging on about.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_123.text: What's all that noise? Seems I didn't get the invitation.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_125.text: Wait 'till I get my hands on that Kanu!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_126.text: This bell ain't just for show.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_127.text: Another bell. Let's give it a ring, see what shakes loose.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_128.text: Don't know who carved this... but it looks too old to be the Order.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_129.text: The Twilight Order aren't sendin' their best, are they?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_130.text: Big operation. Whatever they're after, they want it bad.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_131.text: What is it they're hoping to find here?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_132.text: Oi! You're really pushin' your luck, lady!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_133.text: The whole place is comin' down!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_134.text: This is it, then. All roads lead here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_137.text: You won't regret this... I hope.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_138.text: The old codger's back where he belongs.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_141.text: Tavakai tore through the damn thing like paper...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_143.text: Still kickin'. Knew she had some fight in her.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_144.text: More wreckage. Least I know I'm going the right way.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_147.text: If this is redemption, I'll stick to damnation.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_148.text: Prattle on all you want. We both know who's responsible.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_149.text: Oh, I do love a good treasure hunt!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_A4_150.text: If the Kalguurans grabbed all the good loot, I'll be bloody livid.

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageGoblin_04_01.text: A face only a mother would love!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageGoblin_04_02.text: A face only a mother would love!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_02_01.text: Let's see what you're made of!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_02_02.text: Let's see what you're made of!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_02_03.text: Let's see what you're made of!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTwilightGuard_03_01.text: Take your Utopia and shove it!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTwilightGuard_03_02.text: Take your Utopia and shove it!

StrDex4b_Wild_EngageTwilightGuard_03_03.text: Take your Utopia and shove it!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_01.text: What a lovely little nap. Pity it had to end.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_02.text: Yes, yes, the world is ending. I've heard it all before.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_05.text: Blunt. Brave. Possibly stupid. Time will tell.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_06.text: Charter in hand... time to find a ship.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_07.text: Kalguuran, Karui, I don't care. As long as your ship floats.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_08.text: Funny little beasts with big ambitions. What are they digging for?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_09.text: This radiates power. I must claim it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_10.text: Why cage what you can control?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_11.text: Weaklings. They cage what they fear.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_12.text: What do they want with rhoas?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_14.text: You want a show? Ha! I'll give you a show!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_17.text: Bah! Should've left you for dead!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_18.text: Strength, stripped from a corpse. The best kind.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_19.text: This looks too sophisticated for kinfolk.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_20.text: Excuse me fellow... where's your face? Hahaha!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_21.text: They're bringing the sulphite <i>{here}? What are those little beasts up to?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_22.text: This heat... Hot enough to strip flesh.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_25.text: Seems they don't want to share!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_28.text: I like your lair! Shame about the occupant.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_30.text: Well, well, aren't you a lucky one?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_31.text: Saved your life. Try not to waste it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_32.text: What a strange feeling... Is it the fog causing this?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_33.text: A map... or at least, part of one.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_34.text: Time to piece together this puzzle.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_35.text: The last piece of the puzzle. I should show this to the Karui girl.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_36.text: A pirate's life always ends the same: as a pile of bones on some forgotten shore.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_37.text: The Kalguurans throw ships away like spoiled meat.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_38.text: We'll see if she speaks the truth about this metal.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_42.text: Rare. Dangerous. Volatile. I like it already.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_43.text: This 'Freya' had better thank me for this.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_44.text: Haha! I knew it was all a ruse!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_45.text: I have to hand it to them - <i>{that} was good.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_46.text: I feel no human souls here. Something's wrong.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_48.text: Clawed your way up from the depths... time to put you back!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_49.text: Something tore through here... Wonder if it's still close.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_50.text: Another corpse of a camp, picked clean.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_52.text: Whatever that belongs to... at least it's down there.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_54.text: A shark on land... Almost a pity I had to kill it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_55.text: That singing... My coven calls to me... A deception!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_57.text: Not to my tastes... but Rog may want it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_58.text: All these eggs... Someone's been busy.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_59.text: Oops! Don't think she liked that...

Int4_Gameplay_A4_60.text: They've been petrified. Wish I knew how to do that.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_61.text: I will rip my sisters' voices from your throat!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_64.text: One less thing to track down.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_65.text: The Karui do love their monuments, don't they?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_66.text: Ghosts of Karui past? Dying once wasn't enough, hmm?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_67.text: Kaom's fire - snuffed out. What's next?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_68.text: And I smile upon your flattery.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_69.text: At last, something in this world recognises my talent.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_70.text: Whoever tried to hide this didn't do a very good job.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_71.text: The line between life and death grows ever thinner.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_75.text: The Karui are full of surprises!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_77.text: If you weren't already Navali's, I'd claim you as my own.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_81.text: The Mother of Death... We'd make a good pair.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_82.text: Nice spot for a prison. Not so great if you want to escape.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_83.text: Anyone who makes justice their identity must be <i>{astonishingly} dull.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_84.text: Goes to show how far faith gets you.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_85.text: Got what they deserved, by the looks of it.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_86.text: I must find yet another mechanism.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_89.text: A key. Don't mind if I do.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_90.text: There you are, you slippery little thing.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_93.text: So much suffering. Why not just kill them?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_94.text: Bloody freezing! Though, I needed a bath...

Int4_Gameplay_A4_95.text: With an ominous door like that, how can I resist?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_97.text: This 'Izaro' sure did a number on you.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_101.text: Have to be quicker than that!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_104.text: Nesting grounds. I could smell the filth a mile off.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_105.text: My my... aren't you a sight?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_108.text: What a glorious mess! I'll treasure the memory.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Whatever that shrine is, it's not Karui.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_110.text: Another one. If only I knew what they meant...

Int4_Gameplay_A4_111.text: The Karui are brave to hunt here, I'll give them that.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_114.text: Such sweet smiles... such sharp spears. Curious.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_115.text: This 'Utopia' sounds like a dreadful bore.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_116.text: Arastas again. Let's make this quick, before someone smiles at me.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_117.text: Ugh... What is going on out there? They sure know how to waste a girl's time.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_120.text: Another bell. What does this one do?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_121.text: Ancient markings... and too intricate for those Order halfwits.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_122.text: Down you go, you oversized puppet.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_123.text: All this secrecy... what are they hiding?

Int4_Gameplay_A4_124.text: Impressive architecture. No wonder they love it so.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_125.text: I was about to say the same thing myself.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_126.text: Idiot! You're bringing the whole place down!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_127.text: Here we are at last. Let's hope it was worth the trip.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_128.text: Yes, yes, hello to you too.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_129.text: Hmm. I could just kill my way in... maybe next time.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_130.text: I don't <i>{plan} to desecrate anything... but sometimes it can't be helped.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_131.text: I see you haven't keeled over just yet.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_132.text: I usually enjoy the scent of death... but not like this.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_133.text: Ugh, blood fever... They're as good as corpses already.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_134.text: Tearing down your own walls... A fitting start to a massacre.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_135.text: You're lucky I was passing by.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_136.text: Get out of here, before you end up like the rest of your tribe.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_137.text: You've had your fun! Now it's my turn.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_138.text: If Tavakai wants to slaughter his entire tribe, he's going about it the right way.

Int4_Gameplay_A4_139.text: Give me back my ship captain!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_142.text: It would seem your ancestors disagree!

Int4_Gameplay_A4_143.text: This had better not be a wild goose chase.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: Something claws its way up from below. Time to find out what.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: What pretty little cadavers they make.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_03.text: Something foul stirs beneath the surface.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: The darkness subsides. What a pity.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_05.text: A wound in the earth, left to fester.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: Job's done - for now. I expect there'll be more where that came from.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: What a treat! We must do it again sometime.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: Don't go hiding on me now.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: How deep does this rabbit hole go?

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: Curiosity kills. But I don't mind a little death.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: A lich that won't serve me is better as ash!

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: A cursed little keepsake... and not just for show.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: Ancient secrets! Hmm... less fun when I can't read them.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: Abyssal spoor... Still fresh. How delightful.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: Sealed with something... foul. I won't be going any further just yet.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: The finger twitches in my pocket...

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: Well, only one thing for it...

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: They'll pay for making me do that.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_21.text: Is that supposed to impress me?

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: Dragged from the depths... and into my hands.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: That voice... its power frightens me.

Int4_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: Whatever's waiting below... it'll have to wait a while longer.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_01.text: A fight to the death! Delightful.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_02.text: Don't you recognise a fellow sister? Ugh, no matter!

Int4_Gameplay_P1_03.text: Witches, were you? Could've fooled me.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_04.text: Power clings to this stone... Old and waiting.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_05.text: That did <i>{something}. Can't wait to find out what.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_06.text: Whatever these do, I doubt they're just for show.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_07.text: Ha! You think this circle can hold me?

Int4_Gameplay_P1_10.text: Poisoned roots, whispering trees... I rather like it here.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_14.text: How many people did you gift to your precious Thane?

Int4_Gameplay_P1_15.text: One less sycophant at the Thane's feet.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_16.text: All this wealth... I'm sure they won't miss a coin or two.

Int4_Gameplay_P1_18.text: Sorry to interrupt your little dance!

Int4_Gameplay_P1_19.text: Ogham is free of your torment.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_01.text: What a dump. Too much sand.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_02.text: I step on it - it responds. How intriguing.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_03.text: Awfully big head, yet not enough brains to avoid near-extinction.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_05.text: Nothing like a tomb to lighten my mood.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_07.text: I suppose I could help... maybe...

Int4_Gameplay_P2_09.text: Whoever she was, she's gone now.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_10.text: Seems the Serpent Clan's already slithered through here.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_11.text: Power dwells here, waiting to be claimed.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_13.text: The djinn are silent. Their power is spent.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_14.text: Ugh. I'm already bored of you.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_16.text: As if this place wasn't hot enough already...

Int4_Gameplay_P2_17.text: Fire and bluster - that's all you were.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_18.text: The Black Sekhema... Sounds like a woman of good taste.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_19.text: All this effort to honour the dead. Why not raise them instead?

Int4_Gameplay_P2_20.text: The Maraketh loathe necromancers. Good thing these Sekhemas aren't in any state to protest.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_21.text: If they're offering power, who am I to refuse?

Int4_Gameplay_P2_24.text: Dry as a bone... and just as inviting.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_25.text: Perhaps this will fill the well.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_26.text: A well like this could come in handy.

Int4_Gameplay_P2_27.text: Call yourself a prince? I've seen corpses more fit to rule!

Int4_Gameplay_P3_01.text: Well hello, my little eight-legged friends...

Int4_Gameplay_P3_02.text: Sometimes, we must kill the things we love.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_04.text: So much noise. So little venom.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_05.text: The Azmerian is out of her mind. Fun!

Int4_Gameplay_P3_08.text: I'll pluck the feathers from your frozen carcass!

Int4_Gameplay_P3_09.text: Your corpse belongs to this mountain now.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_12.text: Even the dead shiver up here.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_13.text: Strange. Why don't the monsters attack him?

Int4_Gameplay_P3_14.text: Glad that frozen heap's behind me.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_17.text: If the Vaal still lived, I'd strangle them all myself!

Int4_Gameplay_P3_18.text: When will they learn not to stand in my way?

Int4_Gameplay_P3_19.text: A tomb... of the living? How unnatural.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_20.text: The time of the sparrow has come, or some such nonsense.

Int4_Gameplay_P3_21.text: As much as I'd love to kill you, Doryani and I need your help.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: Do not fear. If evil seeks entry, I will beat it back.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: Clearfell cannot fight this threat forever. I must do my part.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: Their deaths bring quiet - but not peace. Not yet.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: The wound closes. But the will behind it remains.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: I do not require thanks - but you are welcome all the same.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: It flees not in fear - as if called by something deeper still.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: The wound runs deeper than I feared.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: Not made by hands... but by hunger.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: You cling to life. I will cut it free!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: This finger... Cold, but not lifeless.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: This language is unknown to me. The Hooded One may know its meaning.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_14.text: That spire... Vaal work, without question.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: The same black rot as before... The Lost Men unearthed more than just bone.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: Life and death are out of balance here.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: The finger stirs. This place calls to it...

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: A mouth made of earth... and it seeks to swallow me whole.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: It resists me. I lack the means to go on.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_20.text: I'd rather not do that again.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_21.text: You are not of this world. And you are not welcome in it!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_22.text: I will put you down as many times as needed.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: Return to the depths that spawned you!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: Power shaped in the bowels of the deep.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: Born of darkness... but not bound to it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_01.text: How long was I sleeping? Nevermind... I should find Alva.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_04.text: He shapes more than metal. That much is clear.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_05.text: He's bold, for one so young.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_06.text: From the Vastiri to the ocean... My travels have taken me far indeed.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_07.text: She knows these waters. She will guide me well.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_09.text: It hums with power... No wonder these little beasts kneel.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_11.text: Caged strength. They fear what they cannot tame.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_12.text: Another. What war are they preparing for?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_13.text: Even the wilds are not spared their chains.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_15.text: They demand blood. I will give it to them!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_16.text: Flee! Before you meet the same fate!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_18.text: Caged for too long! Turned vicious!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_19.text: The kinfolk aren't the only ones scouring this island.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_21.text: This volcano is no forge. Why do they bring the sulphite here?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_22.text: Solerai herself would swelter in this heat.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_25.text: Power makes believers of us all.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_26.text: Kinfolk do not share power, it seems!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_28.text: Let this volcano be your tomb!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_32.text: You are chained no longer. Go where you will.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_33.text: The fog here clouds my will.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_34.text: Only a piece. The rest must still be out there.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_35.text: The map is complete. Its secrets will follow.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_36.text: The map is complete. Makoru will know how to read it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_37.text: Bones in a cave. A fitting end for a thief.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_39.text: I will search for this Verisium... and her son, if he yet lives.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_42.text: Hah! Your curse holds no power over me!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_44.text: So <i>{this} is Verisium? It shines. I see why they covet it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_45.text: Strange alloy... I'll ask Dannig what he knows.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_46.text: These spikes... The Ezomytes runed something very similar.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_48.text: A cunning trick. May it not bear a bitter cost.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_49.text: Even paradise can sour. Something here has turned.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_52.text: They built... then fled. An all-too-familiar story.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_54.text: Such heavy footfalls... I should be careful.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_55.text: What does that fin belong to?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_57.text: This island grows stranger by the minute.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_58.text: Kaimana will soon have a fin for her brew.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_59.text: Someone may want this. It may yet prove useful.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_60.text: That singing... a trap, woven in song.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_62.text: Hmm. Sir Rog may find a use for this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_63.text: This is no mere spawn - it's an army in waiting.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_65.text: Each and every one of them, turned to stone...

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_66.text: You will not find me such easy prey!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_68.text: Her song ends, and her spell breaks.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_70.text: So this is where the Karui come to test their mettle...

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_71.text: Even death does not dull their pride!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_72.text: A Maraketh earns her blessings, one trial at a time.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_73.text: She knows truth when she sees it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_76.text: The Karui honour me. May I prove worthy of it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_77.text: Where I come from, such marks bring shame.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_79.text: I do not run from a challenge!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_80.text: I do not know this power!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_84.text: He is much more than he appeared.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_86.text: I walk where few dare... and fewer return.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_87.text: Her eyes see further than most dare look.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_88.text: Even the storms cannot wash away what was done here... the place reeks of it.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_89.text: True justice need not declare itself.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_90.text: Faith fed them nothing, in the end.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_91.text: Guard or prisoner - death claimed them all.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_92.text: I must find a way to open this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_95.text: A key. Best keep it close.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_98.text: There is power buried in this place.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_99.text: These prisoners were left to their fates. No wonder madness took them.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_101.text: This was not built to keep people out, but to keep something <i>{in}.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_102.text: Whatever is down here, they left it to drown like vermin.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_103.text: Not this Izaro - but I am your doom!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Your lust for vengeance dies with you!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_110.text: Something wild nests here. And it won't take kindly to visitors.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_111.text: A nest like this... the mother must be monstrous.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_112.text: There you are. The source of all this filth.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_113.text: What is happening? Do my eyes decieve?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_116.text: Foreign work. Old. I don't recognise this craftsmanship.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_117.text: Another shrine... and still no meaning I can grasp.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_118.text: Risking death to prove one's worth... the Karui are not so different from us.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_119.text: Look at the size of those birds... our honoured dead would be eaten whole.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_120.text: A brief calm, amid a storm of Corruption.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_121.text: Their faces wear smiles... but those spears suggest otherwise.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_122.text: I have learned to be wary of any man who promises the sun and the sky.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_123.text: I trust the Order will not begrudge us this visit.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_125.text: Something moves beyond these walls. I should investigate.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_126.text: Now we see the Order's true face!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_128.text: Another bell. What song does this one sing?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_129.text: Unfamiliar etchings... but too old to be the Order's work.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_130.text: Pathetic sycophant. Where are your masters now?

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_131.text: An operation of this scale... whatever they seek, it is no small prize.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_132.text: I should have known you would be involved in this.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_134.text: A place of endings... or new beginnings.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_136.text: Out of respect, I will not intrude.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_137.text: You have shown me grace. I will return it in kind.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_138.text: Your people will be glad to have you back.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_139.text: The air's thick with blood. I must hurry.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_140.text: The blood fever spreads... then we end it, here!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_141.text: Tavakai's strength, turned against his own people... he must be stopped!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_142.text: One soul spared. Progress of a kind.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_143.text: She is stronger than she looks.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_144.text: Blood fever stirs something foul in his heart!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_145.text: Tavakai's wrath has turned pride to ruin.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_147.text: The blood of your people stains your hands!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_148.text: Do you not see what you've become?!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_149.text: Listen to your forebears, while you still can!

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_150.text: Let's hope this map was worth the ink.

Int4b_Gameplay_A4_151.text: A Kalguuran encampment. Best speak to Dannig.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: What he describes... it echoes the stories of what the old Maraketh once faced.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: These beasts... just as the tale-women described in ancient times.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_03.text: So this is the source... It spills forth old power.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: Crude magic. Barely controlled. No wonder it leaks.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_05.text: A tear in the earth. Something pushed through.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: Sealed. Yet I doubt it will hold forever.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: The Maraketh have fought such darkness before. I will not falter now.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: It flees - into the waiting dark.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: So the infection runs deeper than I thought.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: Let us see what festers in the dark.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: Undead filth! Die as you were meant to!

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: A cursed relic - but one which may yet serve a purpose.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: Its meaning escapes me... but perhaps not the Hooded One.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_14.text: The stink of the Vaal is all over this spire.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: More remnants of the Abyssals... Recent ones, too.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: The deeper truths lie beyond. But there is no way forward - yet.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: The lich's finger... it pulses. As if something is calling it home.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: The pit calls, and the flesh obeys.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: It hungers still. I can feel it.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_20.text: Ugh. That fall was... harder than I expected.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_21.text: I stand against the darkness - like my ancestors before me!

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: Return to the dark that birthed you, fell creature!

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_24.text: Even inert, it reeks of the darkness below.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: Grotesque. But power has its uses.

Int4b_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: That voice... I felt it in my very bones.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_01.text: Ice and fire... locked in unending struggle.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_02.text: Both flame and frost shall fail you!

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_03.text: In all things opposed... yet they meet the same end.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_04.text: This stone bristles with old magic.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_05.text: Its purpose eludes me... but the world feels altered somehow.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_07.text: Fell spectre, you will not bind me here!

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_08.text: All that thunder, yet you die with a whimper.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_09.text: Her voice reveals our way forward... again.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_10.text: A whisper of what might be...

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_11.text: Could almost pass for the Wildwood... if one believed the stories.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_12.text: Even the dead peddle their wares.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_16.text: It will not bring back your victims... but may it bring them peace.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_17.text: Pitiful. He hoards gold like it buys him absolution.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_18.text: They dance while their people suffer. Disgusting.

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_19.text: I've danced with scorpions. I'll dance with you too!

Int4b_Gameplay_P1_20.text: Your shadow darkens Ezomyr no more.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_01.text: I never tire of the sight of home.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_03.text: The Titans built monuments to themselves. Now they are the monuments.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_04.text: Their strength lingers... and I will wield it.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_07.text: Come, beasts - I shall bring you the storm!

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_10.text: The Serpent Clan leave a trail of destruction in their wake.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_11.text: Djinn are capricious beings. Even caged, they should be approached with care.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_13.text: The djinn withdraw. Their bargain is fulfilled.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_14.text: Tentacled monstrosity - you have no place here!

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_16.text: I do not fear you, fire-spawn!

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_17.text: Now your blaze is but smoke.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_20.text: A place to honour the <i>{sekhemas} of old.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_21.text: Let her wisdom guide my path.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_22.text: Her name may be dust... but her legacy lives on.

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_27.text: Craven traitor! The Faridun disgrace us yet again!

Int4b_Gameplay_P2_28.text: Asala's throne is not yours to claim!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_05.text: The ice keeps death at bay... for now.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_06.text: Your wings will break against my will!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_07.text: Fall with the snow, feathered thing.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_10.text: A cold to rival the Winter of the World.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_11.text: He doesn't command the monsters, but nor do they attack him. Curious.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_12.text: The worst of the cold is behind me. I hope.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_13.text: Curse the Vaal and their obsession with traps!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_14.text: Another beast led by nothing but its own hunger!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_15.text: The Vaal languished in their own opulence. A pity.

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_16.text: Listen now! The time of the sparrow has come!

Int4b_Gameplay_P3_17.text: Doryani lives. If you wish to as well - then <i>{kneel}.

Int4b_Wild_EngageGoblin_02_01.text: Crawl back to where you belong!

Int4b_Wild_EngageGoblin_02_02.text: Crawl back to where you belong!

Int4b_Wild_EngageGoblin_02_03.text: Crawl back to where you belong!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_01.text: We're here. There goes me last chance at some shut-eye.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_04.text: These Kalguurans don't seem so bad.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_06.text: Got what I need. Time to sail.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_07.text: An Azmeri at sea... Hope I can keep me food down.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_08.text: They're minin' the sulphite. Wonder why.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_11.text: Where's the sport in keepin' a beast caged like this?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_12.text: These kinfolk are a damn disease.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_13.text: Poor beasts. They didn't ask for this.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_14.text: If anythin' needs cagin', it's the bloody kinfolk.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_15.text: Bet you lot think you're clever for this!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_16.text: Not so clever now, are ya?!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_18.text: Primitive little bastards thought they had me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_19.text: Hmm. No kinfolk made this. This here's man-made.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_21.text: Not the most invitin' place I've ever been...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_22.text: Ugh... I'm sweatin' through layers I didn't know I had.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_23.text: Sod off, the both o' ya!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_26.text: Throwin' a tantrum, are we? Huh?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_27.text: Rot in yer own stink, ya feckless bastard!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_32.text: Go on, now. Get far away from here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_33.text: Don't much like this fog. Makes me skin crawl.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_34.text: Part of a map, looks like. Where's the rest of it?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_36.text: Ought to find Makoru. She'll know what to make of it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_37.text: The world won't mourn another pirate.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_38.text: They keep throwin' ships at this place. It keeps throwin' 'em back.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_39.text: Aye, I'll keep a lookout for your boy.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_42.text: Ain't got time for your flamin' curses!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_44.text: You were dead already. I just made it stick.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_46.text: This ain't from any vein I've seen.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_48.text: Not to worry, Freya. I'll have you out in a moment.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_51.text: Summat strange about this island... Those boats've been here an age.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_52.text: Where'd you bloody well come from?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_53.text: Knew summat weren't right about this place.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_54.text: Forced out, like rats from a burrow.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_55.text: Scattered to the winds, same as the last.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_56.text: That ain't any beast I know.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_59.text: Sharks on land... What fresh nonsense will I find next?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_62.text: Weren't expectin' a serenade. Feels like it's pullin' me in.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_64.text: That's a right pretty pearl. Rog'll like that.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_65.text: Not so much a nest as a damn infestation...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_67.text: So you're what's been makin' all this bloody noise!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_70.text: Shame he couldn't show up <i>{during} the fight.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_71.text: Now there's a sight what'll take your breath away.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_72.text: Their spirits linger, same as their strength.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_73.text: If I've learned one thing, it's that strength talks.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_74.text: I do what I have to. Bravery's got nowt to do with it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_75.text: These ancestors talk more than the Spirit ever did.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_76.text: This were well-hidden... but not well enough!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_77.text: Banished from me own mountain, but welcome here... Funny that.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_79.text: What's a damn monkey doin' here?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_80.text: Well now - this should be fun!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_83.text: Fate or fortune? I'll take either.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_84.text: Of all the places I thought I'd end up, this weren't one o' them...

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_85.text: The Mother of Death, is it? Best keep on 'er good side.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_86.text: Looks like the sort of place no one walks out of.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_87.text: Pretty word, justice. There's not many who live up to it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_88.text: Spent their last breath on prayer. Lot o' good it did 'em.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_89.text: Starve the prisoners, get eaten. There's justice for ya.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_90.text: Need to find a way through.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_94.text: Reckon I know where this goes.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_95.text: Goddess o' Justice ain't keen on sharin', I suppose.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_97.text: Sent these prisoners' to their graves, leavin' 'em trapped down here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_98.text: That wave near took me legs out!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_99.text: Whoever built this weren't takin' any chances.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_100.text: Weren't me who put you here - but I'll set you free!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_106.text: Eternal Empire's long dead... yet their stench remains.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_107.text: This island makes warriors... or meals.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Afraid to fight me yourself? Come on!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_111.text: Filth like you don't belong in the skies.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_112.text: Don't know who built that - but it weren't any folk I know.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_113.text: More shrines. More questions without answer.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_114.text: The Karui are brave. Bravery means little to a ragin' mother bird.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_115.text: Brood's even bigger than I thought.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_117.text: They smile... but hold weapons. I trust neither.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_118.text: I wish 'em luck with their Utopia. They'll need it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_119.text: Where's that preacher go to? And who's makin' that noise?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_120.text: Ugh! Always knew it were an act!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_122.text: Reckon this one'll twist things too.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_123.text: I've not seen signs like this before.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_125.text: What are the Order playing at with all this?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_126.text: Summat tells they're not diggin' for just any artefact.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_127.text: Agh. Of course it'd be <i>{you}. What is it now?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_129.text: Spirit led me true. This here's the place.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_131.text: Aye, as you say. I'll stay right here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_132.text: Sacred ground ain't new to me. I'll tread careful.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_133.text: Feels good to see 'im back with 'is people.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_134.text: Spirit's breath... Am I too late?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_135.text: They've gone mad with blood fever!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_136.text: Tavakai might be off his rocker, but aye, he's strong.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_137.text: Most would be long dead - but not her.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_138.text: Still standin', eh? That's a relief.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_139.text: This ain't the work of a warrior. This is madness.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_141.text: You got that right. Let's finish this!

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_143.text: Ya bloody fool! Why won't you listen?

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_144.text: The map leads here. Let's hope it weren't a wild goose chase.

Dex4b_Gameplay_A4_145.text: Kalguurans got here first. Wonder if Dannig knows anythin'.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: Aye. I'll put a stop to it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: Not o' this world, that's for sure.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_03.text: That ain't just a crack. It's a wound on the earth.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_04.text: That's done it. Kill 'em, and it closes.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_05.text: That'll be the hole they've been spillin' out from.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: Whatever they are, I'll keep killin' 'em 'til they stop comin'.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: There it goes - down that hole!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_09.text: Reckon I'll find the answers I need down there.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_10.text: The deeper I go, the fouler it gets.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: Another walkin' corpse - guess I'll finish the job!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: Nasty, this. But could come in handy - no pun intended.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: Either I've lost it, or this is gibberish. Best ask the Hooded One.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_14.text: This here's Vaal work. Got to be.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_15.text: Lost Men went diggin' where they shouldn't. Now we're all stuck with the consequences.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: I ain't afraid o' the dark. Dark should be afraid o' me.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: The lich's finger won't sit still. Summat calls to it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: Couldn't be a normal key, could it? Had to be a bloody finger.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: Deeper it goes, but I've nowt to get me there just now.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_21.text: Have you blighters forgotten how to die?!

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: Rot in your pit, where you belong.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_24.text: Tainted, this. Got the stench o' death on it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: I've no love for the dark... but this here's got bite.

Dex4b_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: Don't like the sound o' him one bit...

Dex4b_Gameplay_EndGame_111.text: Here he sleeps. His bravery won't be forgotten.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_01.text: Fire and ice... Same ol' story.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_02.text: Just the two of ya? You'll need a whole coven to stop me!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_04.text: This here's got a pulse to it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_06.text: Guessin' these are for more than just decoration.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_07.text: I'll cut down any who stand in my way!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_09.text: The Spirit guides me once more!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_10.text: No! What cruel fate! Don't leave me again!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_11.text: This here speaks - if you know how to listen.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_12.text: Never walked the Wildwood, but this place feels... familiar, somehow.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_13.text: A ghost with goods? Sure. Why not.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_17.text: You fed prisoners to your Thane. Now it's your turn!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_18.text: A quicker death than you deserve... but it'll have to do.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_19.text: Won't have much use for coin where he's goin'.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_20.text: What the feck are they dancin' for?

Dex4b_Gameplay_I1_22.text: Pranced around all fancy-like... and still died ugly!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_01.text: Here we are again. Wonder how Asala's been keepin'.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_03.text: Big bastard met an even bigger end.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_04.text: Feels like thunder in me bones.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_05.text: Can hardly spit without hittin' a tomb around here.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_06.text: He's in a spot o' bother.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_07.text: Reckon she could point me in the right direction?

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_09.text: Serpent Clan ain't subtle. Place is smashed to bits.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_11.text: Seems the djinn are feelin' generous.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_12.text: No more whispers. They've given all they can.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_13.text: Few too many tentacles for my likin'!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_15.text: Even the hottest fires burn out!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_16.text: One o' them ancient <i>{sekhemas}. Must've done summat fierce to earn a shrine like this.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_17.text: Seven waters... seven statues. Reckon these Maraketh need to learn some other numbers.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_18.text: Old strength, made new in me hands.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_19.text: Her statue may be broken, aye... but her power ain't.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_21.text: Serves you right, you lil' git.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_22.text: Well's empty. Not surprisin', given where we are.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_23.text: This ain't just water. It's summat else.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_24.text: Hah! All that one from one drop?

Dex4b_Gameplay_I2_25.text: You Faridun never learn, do ya?

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_03.text: Buzz off, the lot o' ya.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_04.text: The Spirit would never bid you kill your own!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_05.text: That's the last time you dirty the Spirit's name!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_06.text: Damn things are still alive in there!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_07.text: I'll tear those wings clean off!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_08.text: More limbs, more ways to bleed!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_10.text: I've not felt cold like this since I left the Ranges.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_11.text: Is that an Azmeri Elder? What's he doin' 'ere?

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_12.text: Spirit's breath... Thought I'd freeze solid back there.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_13.text: That's bait if ever I've seen it.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_14.text: Knew it. Never as easy as it looks.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_15.text: I've come too far to let a brute like you stop me!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_16.text: All the wealth in the world can't buy your way out o' the grave.

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_17.text: Listen up! The time of the sparrow has come!

Dex4b_Gameplay_I3_18.text: Enough fightin'. Doryani and I need your help.

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_04.text: Spirit's breath, that were hard goin'!

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_05.text: Spirit's breath, that were hard goin'!

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_06.text: Spirit's breath, that were hard goin'!

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_07.text: That's the last I'll be hearin' of them!

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_08.text: That's the last I'll be hearin' of them!

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_09.text: That's the last I'll be hearin' of them!

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_10.text: Back to the dark with ya!

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_11.text: Back to the dark with ya!

Dex4b_Wild_AbyssComplete_12.text: Back to the dark with ya!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_01.text: Ugh, my neck... I'm getting too old to sleep in the back of a cart.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_04.text: This forge... I can only imagine what Father would accomplish with such tools.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_05.text: Straight to the point. I can respect that.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_06.text: Now, let's see about that ship.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_07.text: Another Karui, adrift from her people. She and I are not so different.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_08.text: They are mining this substance? For what purpose?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_09.text: The kinfolk seem drawn to this... and so am I.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_11.text: A prisoner, far from its kind. I know the feeling.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_12.text: Another prison of the kinfolk's making.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_13.text: Such cruelty, to cage beasts like this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_14.text: These kinfolk cannot build - only bind.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_16.text: Not so brave without your beast!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_17.text: Go with the First Ones. You are free now.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_18.text: No! I only meant to free you!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_19.text: A gift of blood and battle.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_21.text: This poor man... There is little honour in such a death.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_22.text: So this is where they're bringing the sulphite... but why?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_23.text: This heat! How do they survive down here?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_24.text: The mountain rises to meet me!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_26.text: I've seen kinfolk kill for scraps, but this... this they revere.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_34.text: The fog here... There's something off about it.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_35.text: This looks like part of a map... but where does it lead?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_36.text: These map pieces fit together. Now to see where it leads.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_37.text: That's the last piece. I wonder what Makoru makes of it.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_38.text: Pirates, so close to Karui shores...

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_39.text: So many ships lost, and still the Kalguurans come.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_40.text: This fog only grows thicker... I should move quickly.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_41.text: If she has hope for her son, I will do my best.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_42.text: That noise... It's going to blow!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_43.text: Learned my lesson the first time!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_46.text: Here it is - the metal Freya spoke of.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_47.text: I would study this metal, but I need to return to Freya.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_50.text: Strange... These boats look to have been abandoned for some time.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_52.text: What happened here? Where have the people gone?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_53.text: Another settlement destroyed. Something is very wrong here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_55.text: The size of that fin... At least it can't reach me up here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_57.text: That voice... it's beautiful. And disturbing.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_58.text: Bit fancy for me. But Rog may want it.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_59.text: A brood this big is no accident.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_60.text: The singing's stopped. Hmm... that's no comfort.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_63.text: I walk in the shadow of the gods. May they look well upon me.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_65.text: A trial by fire - and still I stand.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_66.text: We are not born brave. We become it.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_67.text: Is that... the Mother of Death herself?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_68.text: Wasn't expecting to find this here...

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_69.text: If I am truly Karui, let me prove it here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_71.text: Their mark on my skin. I will wear it proudly.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_73.text: A glimpse of something yet to come.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_74.text: I should be on the lookout for more of these.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_76.text: To stand before the Mother of Death... I am unworthy.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_77.text: Eternal stone. I've seen it before, choking Ezomyr - and now poisoning this shore.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_78.text: I wonder... did she ever stand for justice, or just claim it?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_79.text: A place of worship... and still no salvation came.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_80.text: Dead guards... consumed by the hunger they helped create.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_84.text: This should get me where I need to go.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_85.text: Let their power serve a just purpose, for once.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_87.text: Whatever's down here... they really didn't want getting out.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_88.text: Many Karui have walked these shores before me.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_89.text: What drives my people to collect these eggs?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_90.text: That's no Karui shrine. Whose is it, then?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_91.text: More of these shrines. What are they?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_92.text: My ancestors hunted here... and now, so do I.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_93.text: Friendly sorts, this Twilight Order. Or so they seem.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_94.text: Heavily armed, for such peaceful hosts.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_95.text: I hope their 'Utopia' is what they say it is.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_97.text: What's going on out there? I should take a look.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_99.text: Another bell. What does this one do?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_101.text: All this digging... What are they looking for?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_102.text: This isn't just an excavation. They seem obsessed with what lies beneath.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_107.text: Your wisdom is needed now more than ever.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_108.text: This was Tavakai's to protect... Now it burns by his hand...

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Amid all this ruin... she alone endures.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_110.text: She survived. That's something, at least.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_111.text: This is it. The trail of devastation ends here.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_112.text: This is where the map leads. But is the treasure still here?

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_113.text: Kalguuran craft. Dannig ought to see this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_114.text: This was not born of earth alone.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_117.text: Rot on the tide, foul one!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_119.text: Kaimana will want to see this.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_122.text: You fed on my kin. Now choke on their fury!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_124.text: Justice for every last Karui life you claimed!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_127.text: A warrior worthy of these hallowed halls.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_130.text: What have they done to you?!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_136.text: I need to keep him still!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_138.text: Saqawal would never allow such a creature in his skies!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_141.text: Perhaps now the Karui can visit this place once more.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_142.text: You want a fight? You've got one!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_143.text: Your masters will soon go the same way!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_144.text: You will pay for what you've done to Ogham!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_145.text: He'll bring this whole site down if this keeps up!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_146.text: They opened the way. I'll walk it with care.

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_148.text: I am sorry, my brothers! You leave me choice!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_150.text: Then let the ancestors bear witness!

Str4b_Gameplay_A4_152.text: Heed the ancestors' words! Before it's too late!

Str4b_Gameplay_EndGame_110.text: The Hooded One sleeps... Damned Cataclysm.

Str4b_Gameplay_P1_01.text: When frost fights flame... none walk away unscathed.

Str4b_Gameplay_P1_02.text: These stones... Not just for show, I'd wager.

Str4b_Gameplay_P1_03.text: Clouds swirl... There's a storm ahead.

Str4b_Gameplay_P1_06.text: I've heard tales of the Wildwood... This places brings them to mind.

Str4b_Gameplay_P1_08.text: I saw one of these spring to life back in Geonor's manor.

Str4b_Gameplay_P1_09.text: More people caged and left to die. He's no better than Geonor.

Str4b_Gameplay_P1_10.text: Stolen wealth. Let it serve a more noble purpose.

Str4b_Gameplay_I1_13.text: You stood side by side... but never as one!

Str4b_Gameplay_I1_14.text: Only one of us walks away from here!

Str4b_Gameplay_I1_16.text: The Draíocht moves through me... ancient and alive.

Str4b_Gameplay_I1_18.text: You meted out 'justice'. Now face it yourself!

Str4b_Gameplay_I1_19.text: Death is too good for you... but justice demands it.

Str4b_Gameplay_I1_20.text: You are a disgrace to the First Ones!

Str4b_Gameplay_I1_21.text: As foul an influence as Geonor - and now, you share his fate.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_01.text: The Vastiri's just as hot as I remember.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_02.text: That did something. I should look out for more.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_03.text: A titan... or what's left of one.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_05.text: I'd know the stench of undead anywhere.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_07.text: The Serpent Clan's already been through here.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_09.text: Hmm. Still not sure I trust it.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_10.text: I'm done with these Djinn. I hope they're done with me.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_12.text: Seven pillars. One shattered... and doesn't look to be by accident.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_13.text: Thank you, <i>{sekhema}. I'll carry it well.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_14.text: They tried to erase her, but her power endures.

Str4b_Gameplay_P2_15.text: This well waits for something. An offering, perhaps?

Str4b_Gameplay_I2_19.text: I've faced down worse than you!

Str4b_Gameplay_I2_20.text: Stand down - or be put down!

Str4b_Gameplay_I2_21.text: May you rot like the rest.

Str4b_Gameplay_I2_23.text: Fire always burns out, in the end.

Str4b_Gameplay_I2_26.text: I see no future king. Only a traitor!

Str4b_Gameplay_I2_27.text: You die without a throne, as you should!

Str4b_Gameplay_P3_05.text: Let the wind howl. I still stand.

Str4b_Gameplay_P3_07.text: Strange. The monsters act like he's not even there...

Str4b_Gameplay_P3_09.text: Takes more than a trap to kill me.

Str4b_Gameplay_P3_10.text: All these fancy tombs, and for what? Even the richest man rots.

Str4b_Gameplay_I3_12.text: There's no honour in what you've become!

Str4b_Gameplay_I3_13.text: You died as you lived - lost.

Str4b_Gameplay_I3_14.text: I'll rip you from the sky!

Str4b_Gameplay_I3_15.text: One less predator to plague the skies.

Str4b_Gameplay_I3_16.text: I will match you, strength for strength!

Str4b_Gameplay_I3_17.text: No more rage. No more ruin.

Str4b_Gameplay_I3_20.text: Vaal, heed me! The time of the sparrow has come!

Str4b_Gameplay_I3_21.text: I am not your enemy! I stand with Doryani.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_01.text: This is my home. I won't let it fall.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_02.text: I won't leave Clearfell's safety to chance again.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_03.text: The ground shudders... and the light withers.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_05.text: There. That's where they're crawling out from.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_06.text: The pit's closed. But I doubt that's the end of it.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_07.text: If they come again, they'll find me waiting.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_08.text: What is that? It flees into the earth!

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_09.text: Some wounds don't close on their own.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_12.text: I can't make sense of this. Perhaps the Hooded One can.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_13.text: This looks Vaal in origin. I should speak with Doryani.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_14.text: The Lost Men dug too deep. Now we all pay the price.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_15.text: Can't go further without some sort of offering.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_16.text: The finger reacts. Something down here remembers it.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_17.text: It calls... and the finger answers.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_18.text: Life above. Death below. And something waiting in between.

Str4b_Gamplay_Abyss_20.text: Touched by death. Yet still mine to wield.

Str4b_Gameplay_Abyss_22.text: Let's see if you still bleed!

Str4b_Gameplay_Abyss_23.text: You belong down here - and I'll see that you stay!

Str4b_Gameplay_Abyss_24.text: You rise again, you fall again!

Str4b_Gameplay_Abyss_25.text: The surface is not yours to take!

Str4b_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: That voice chills me to the marrow.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_01.text: We're here... Guess it's time to wake up.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_03.text: These Kalguurans are a bit familiar for my liking.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_04.text: A man who knows when to shut up. I like him already.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_06.text: That's the charter sorted. Now let's see about this ship.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_07.text: Take me where I need to go and we'll get along nicely.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_09.text: Anything the kinfolk revere is bound to be trouble.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_12.text: These kinfolk spread like mould, turning everything sour.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_13.text: They cage what should be left to roam.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_14.text: Is there anything on this island they haven't ruined?

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_15.text: Guess I'm fighting my way out!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_17.text: Sick way to get your kicks. Who's the real monster here?

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_18.text: Fools. Let the wild be wild.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_19.text: This work's too tidy for kinfolk. Someone else has been here.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_20.text: A cruel death - and one I plan to avoid.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_22.text: Trust kinfolk to set up shot in the least hospitable place in Wraeclast.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_23.text: Power enough to even make kinfolk kneel...

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_27.text: Do I <i>{look} like one of your vile spawn?

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_29.text: Wasn't expecting to find anyone alive in here.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_30.text: Go now. Get yourself to safety.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_32.text: Not much use on its own. But if I could find the rest of it...

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_33.text: Map's whole now. Time to move.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_34.text: Let's see where this leads. Makoru should know.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_35.text: A good pirate's a dead pirate.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_36.text: Wrecked, like so many others. That's what greed buys you.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_37.text: Doubt I'll find her son... but can't hurt to keep an eye out.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_40.text: Then it's time I lifted the 'curse'.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_42.text: Hope this does what Freya says it will.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_43.text: Never seen metal like this before. Maybe Dannig has.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_47.text: I've gone and done it now!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_48.text: These boats are wrecked. Doubt the owner fared any better.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_49.text: What in Craiceann's name is that?

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_50.text: Well... guess I'm having crab tonight.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_51.text: Thought they could carve out a home. Nature had other ideas.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_52.text: The island chewed these people up and spat them back out.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_53.text: I've heard plenty of beasts in my time... Never heard <i>{that} before.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_54.text: That's some fin. Clearly no common beast.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_56.text: This island is all kinds of wrong.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_57.text: Kaimana will get her fin, sure enough.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_59.text: That singing... Ulratha herself? No. It can't be.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_61.text: Pretty, but ultimately useless. Rog'll love it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_64.text: Her song was the last thing these people ever heard...

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_65.text: You're no Ulratha! But a charlatan all the same!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_67.text: Peace on the air. At last.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_69.text: By the First Ones... It's big enough to bury a god.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_70.text: Dead or not, they'll see what I'm made of!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_71.text: You don't survive what I've survived by being weak.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_72.text: You'll forgive me if I don't smile back.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_74.text: Knew there'd be something back here.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_76.text: If it helps me fight, I'll take it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_77.text: What's a monkey doing down here?

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_80.text: See all, do you? Did you see <i>{that} coming?

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_82.text: So my reward for passing the trials is... death itself.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_83.text: She's seen more than I ever will.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_84.text: Stinks of death, even from out here. That can't be good.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_85.text: Justice bends easy when you're the one holding the scales.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_86.text: The gods make for poor company on an empty stomach.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_87.text: Looks like the guards got a taste of their own cruelty.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_91.text: A key. Better hold onto this.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_94.text: The Goddess of Justice - behind bars. How fitting.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_95.text: The Eternals made monsters of these prisoners - <i>{and} of themselves.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_96.text: Oof! That cold hits like a punch to the gut.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_98.text: Izaro left you to rot. I'll finish the job.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_104.text: As dead as the rest of this miserable place!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_105.text: Signs of nesting. Which means I'm <i>{definitely} not welcome.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_106.text: With eggs this big, I'd hate to see the mother.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_107.text: There you are. Knew you'd come squawking!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_109.text: Eugh. Stay in there this time!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_111.text: Strange place for a shrine. Can't tell who made it, either.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_112.text: Another shrine - and still no closer to knowing what they mean.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_113.text: Karui call this a trial. I call it a death wish.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_114.text: These things are everywhere. More hatchery than hunting ground.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_115.text: They call it order... but order never lasts.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_116.text: They welcome me... with weapons. Curious hospitality.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_117.text: Any old fool can promise paradise. Doesn't mean you'll live to see it.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_118.text: Just want to get in and out without them preaching at me.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_123.text: Whatever made these markings was ancient. Too old to be the Order.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_124.text: Your Saviour's just another butcher hiding behind faith.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_126.text: Whatever the Order thinks they'll find here, I'll make sure they don't.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_127.text: It seems we're running the same paths!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_129.text: This is it. Whatever comes next, I'm ready.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_131.text: As you wish. I'm not looking to start something.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_132.text: Don't worry. I know how to tread lightly.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_134.text: Place is torn to pieces. Is this Tavakai's doing?

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_136.text: Not hard to see which way Tavakai went...

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_137.text: Didn't think I'd find anyone still breathing.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_138.text: Still got your wits about you. That's a minor miracle.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_139.text: Trail's getting fresher. He's not far.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_141.text: Right you are. Let's end this!

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_144.text: Treasure or trap? Only one way to find out.

Dex4_Gameplay_A4_145.text: This camp... Dannig's people, no doubt.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_01.text: Whatever's beneath Clearfell... I'll bury it deeper.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_02.text: This land is my home. I'll drive these invaders out.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_03.text: That must be where they're coming from.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_05.text: Kill them and it closes. Question is - for how long?

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_06.text: An even deeper fissure than the first.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_07.text: Done. Let them rot down there.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_08.text: Won the battle, not the war. More'll come - I'm sure of it.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_11.text: This place... it's like it hasn't known light. Ever.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_12.text: Come on then. Old bones break easy!

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_13.text: Could've done without the souvenir... Still, might come in handy.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_14.text: Can't understand a lick of that. Maybe the Hooded One can.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_16.text: This looks freshly dug... and the Abyssal rot is already spreading.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_17.text: I get the feeling I'm not welcome here...

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_18.text: The finger's twitching... Whatever's down there wants it back.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_19.text: The lich's finger points the way... right into the pit.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_20.text: The truth's down there somewhere. Just need the means to reach it.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_22.text: Whatever you are - you die here!

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_24.text: Stay dead this time. Or don't. I'll gladly kill you again.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_26.text: Not pretty. But it might come in handy.

Dex4_Gameplay_Abyss_27.text: That sounded... not of this world.

Dex4_Gameplay_EndGame_112.text: He's out. He did all he could...

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_02.text: Alright, then! Which one of you wants to die first?

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_03.text: Couldn't kill each other, so you tried me instead. Bad idea.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_04.text: A monument to the First Ones.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_05.text: I feel Farrul's eyes upon me.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_06.text: Something left its mark here - something ancient.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_07.text: I've slept through storms worse than you!

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_10.text: Bad sign. Might mean worse ahead.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_11.text: My mother used to talk of the Wildwood. This feels just like it.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_12.text: Not the most inviting storefront I've ever seen...

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_15.text: Lucky they weren't the Thane's next meal.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_16.text: You dragged folk from <i>{my} wood to feed your Thane. That ends now.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_17.text: All your cruelty, paid in full.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_18.text: How nice of our dear Thane, to keep this all in one place for me.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_19.text: Let them dance. It'll be their last.

Dex4_Gameplay_P1_20.text: Justice came for the rest of your men. Now it comes for you!

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_01.text: The Vastiri sun burns as hot as ever.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_04.text: Their strength is now my own.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_05.text: Let's put some undead back in their graves.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_06.text: Oh, alright then. I suppose I should help.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_07.text: Is that what I think it is?

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_09.text: Looks like the Serpent Clan's been busy.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_10.text: Only a fool trusts a Djinn... but needs must.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_12.text: One last wish. I should quit while I'm still ahead.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_13.text: What twisted rite spat you out?

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_14.text: Let the sands bury you deep!

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_15.text: Sputtered out like a campfire in the wind!

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_16.text: One of the ancient <i>{sekhemas}. Still drawing reverence after all this time.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_17.text: Seven pillars... but one's been all but erased.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_18.text: The <i>{sekhemas} of old watch over the desert still.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_19.text: Don't care what she did. I'll take her strength all the same.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_21.text: Maybe the next 'vase' will think twice.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_22.text: A well... but it's run dry.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_23.text: Only a drop... yet heavy as a flood.

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_25.text: Call yourself a prince? Then I'll give you a royal ending!

Dex4_Gameplay_P2_26.text: Some prince. Bled like any other.

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_01.text: The webs of Fenumus run deep.

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_05.text: You turned on your own. That I can't forgive!

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_06.text: Go join the ones you butchered.

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_10.text: That's what mindless brawn gets you.

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_11.text: This cold... Never known anything like it.

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_13.text: From the snowy mountaintops to the valley down below.

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_14.text: Dead men don't need treasure. I do.

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_15.text: Only one thing to do with a beast like you!

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_17.text: Must've cost a fortune to rot this lavishly.

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_18.text: The time of the sparrow has come!

Dex4_Gameplay_P3_19.text: Your precious Doryani and I stand together. Join us - or die.

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_01_01.text: Picked the wrong hole to crawl out of!

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_01_02.text: Picked the wrong hole to crawl out of!

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_01_03.text: Picked the wrong hole to crawl out of!

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_03_01.text: I can do this as many times as it takes!

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_03_02.text: I can do this as many times as it takes!

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_03_03.text: I can do this as many times as it takes!

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_04_01.text: Next time, I won't be so gentle.

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_04_02.text: Next time, I won't be so gentle.

Dex4_Wild_AbyssComplete_04_03.text: Next time, I won't be so gentle.

Dex4_Wild_EngageBloodKarui_02_01.text: No choice but to put you down!

Dex4_Wild_EngageBloodKarui_02_02.text: No choice but to put you down!

Dex4_Wild_EngageBloodKarui_02_03.text: No choice but to put you down!

Dex4_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_01_03.text: Think you can stop me, eh?

Dex4_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_04_01.text: Am I supposed to feel honoured?

Dex4_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_04_02.text: Am I supposed to feel honoured?

Dex4_Wild_EngageTrialKarui_04_03.text: Am I supposed to feel honoured?

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_01.text: Two forces fated to clash... yet neither can prevail.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_02.text: Your fates will be as one.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_03.text: In life, divided. In death, united.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_04.text: These stones were placed with purpose.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_05.text: The sky trembles... A storm approaches.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_07.text: I called you forth. I'll send you back.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_I2_29.text: I feel the Draíocht move through me.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_10.text: This places resembles the Wildwood - at least, what I've heard of it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_13_02.text: So this is the Thane's idea of justice.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_14.text: Warden of suffering... your time is up.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_15.text: You fed the dark. Now it consumes you.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_16.text: Ill-gotten gains. I'll put them to better use.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_17.text: A dance of death and vanity. How grotesque.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_18.text: Together you ruled - together you'll fall!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P1_19.text: Ezomyr is free of your poisonous influence at last.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_01.text: The sands shift, yet the Vastiri stays the same.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_02.text: It responds to my touch. I suspect there'll be more.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_03.text: The titans must have been something to behold.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_04.text: Imbued with the strength of long-dead titans.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_05.text: Not all who inhabit this tomb lie still.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_06.text: Another soul, caught in the swarm. I should help.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_07.text: How many lives have you claimed between you? No more!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_09.text: Little more than a trick of the mind.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_10.text: The Serpent Clan have left their mark here.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_11.text: Djinn bound in stone, waiting to tempt the living.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_12.text: When it comes to Djinn, gifts rarely come without cost.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_13.text: One can only hope they don't come demanding recompense.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_14.text: Let the desert drink of your blood.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_16.text: Flame where water once flowed. I'll see balance restored!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_17.text: Perhaps now water can flow once more.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_18.text: I have heard tell of this 'Black <i>{Sekhema}'.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_20.text: My call was heard. The <i>{Sekhema} stirs.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_21.text: Even in disgrace, she offers strength.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_24.text: A vessel, waiting to be filled.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_25.text: A single drop of water... yet with the weight of many.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_27.text: Ambition like yours deserves no quarter!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P2_28.text: A tyrant uncrowned is still a tyrant.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_02.text: Their wings hum like a warning.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_04.text: You shall not blunt my resolve!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_06.text: Held in ice... but not freed from suffering.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_07.text: The sky will not grieve your loss.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_08.text: Violence defines you. Now it will end you!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_09.text: Strength without purpose is nothing but noise.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_10.text: The wind cuts deep. This land offers no welcome.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_11.text: Monsters seem to steer clear of him. How strange.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_13.text: Traps. How very like the Vaal.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_14.text: Greed was their legacy. And their downfall.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_15.text: Your hunger will find no feast here.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_17.text: A monument to excess. Like every Vaal tomb before it.

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_18.text: The time of the sparrow has come!

DexInt4b_Gameplay_P3_19.text: Join me. Blood need not bind you forever.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_01.text: Can't we all just get along?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_02.text: Glad I could help you set aside your differences!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_03.text: You fought together, you died together. How sweet.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_04.text: No idea what this does... which usually means something awful's about to happen.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_06.text: Wonder what these do. Only one way to find out.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_07.text: That's one less horror haunting this place.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_08.text: Felt that right in my bones.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_09.text: Omen, relic, whatever this is - bet it brings trouble.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_10.text: Something about this grove gives me the creeps.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_11.text: Is that the Hooded One's brother or something?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_12.text: Too smart to fall for this again!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_14.text: Curse my bleedin' heart. Guess I should let 'em out.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_15.text: I've seen your handiwork. You don't get to walk away!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_16.text: That's for every poor bastard you fed to your Thane!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_17.text: Oh-ho-ho, would you look at this?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_18.text: Of all the things I expected to see... that wasn't one of them.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_19.text: You made your bed. Now lie in it.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I1_20.text: The only throne you're fit for is an outhouse.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_01.text: Ugh. Here we are again, in the arse-end of nowhere.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_03.text: Guess even giants can get their heads kicked in.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_08.text: Guess they had somewhere to be.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_09.text: Serpent Clan sure made a mess of this place.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_10.text: Djinn. Always pays to be careful when dealin' with those tricksy bastards.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_11.text: Guess the stories had some truth in 'em.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_12.text: That's the last of 'em. Nothin' left to give.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_13.text: I've filled whole graveyards with your kind.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_14.text: Getting real good at killing the already-dead.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_15.text: You'll be cinders when I'm through with ya!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_17.text: Don't know who this is, but I'll take her bargain all the same.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_18.text: Seven pillars, seven names... but one's been scrubbed out.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_19.text: Let's see what a <i>{sekhema's} favour buys me.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_20.text: Forgotten, broken... just my kind of patron.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_22.text: Couldn't just let me have it, could you?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_23.text: A well... Scratch that. An <i>{empty} well.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_24.text: Won't fill the well, but it's a start.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_25.text: Huh. Guess it <i>{did} fill the well after all.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_26.text: You Faridun just don't get it!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I2_27.text: Time's up, you dusty old bastard.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_01.text: Spiders. Why'd it have to be spiders?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_05.text: Are all Azmeri insane, or is it just you?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_06.text: I think I did you a favour, truth be told.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_07.text: Still alive... I'll have a fight on my hands if I break them outta here.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_09.text: That's what you get, you overgrown chicken.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_11.text: Should've been a big game hunter.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_12.text: I'm freezing my arse off up here...

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_14.text: Almost lost a toe to frostbite back there.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_15.text: If it's Vaal, you can be sure it'll be trapped.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_17.text: What rock did you crawl out from?

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_18.text: Never come between a man and his next payday.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_19.text: The Vaal sure do love their tombs.

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_20.text: The time of the sparrow has come!

StrDex4b_Gameplay_I3_21.text: Give it up. You, me, Doryani - temporary allies, like it or not.
